transport: UTF-8 JSON-RPC 2.0, one object per line, no batches
compatibility: Exact protocol match is mandatory. No legacy migration or protocol fallback.

ownership.android: Workbench presentation, connection profiles, workspace-delivered local configuration, disposable projections and local Android capability execution
ownership.engine: Workspace transactions, imports and collision allocation, chat adapters and submission ledger, tool installation, terminal resources and desired local-service operations
ownership.guestChat: Engine-supervised JVM service; private persistence through allowlisted Rust callbacks, no writable private-state mount
ownership.localServices: Boot-bound executor epochs and measured operation receipts; no automatic replay of unknown outcomes

embeddedLifetime: Stdio transport closure stops the Server and owned processes. Reconnect rehydrates committed state; there is no detached or remote execution promise.
